hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/dr-julian-g-bruce-st-george-island-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('60 campsites with electricity, water hookups and a dump station that is nearby') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 54 web-bookable units Electric Hookup 50; water listed on 50; no sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 60 campsites behind the historic dunes in pine flatwoods, a quarter-mile from the beach with no Gulf views; 54 are bookable online, all but one back-in (per-site limits 26-43 ft). Six concrete sites with sidewalks to the restrooms are the accessible ones. Hammock camping allowed at every site.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/dr-julian-g-bruce-st-george-island-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Maximum RV length = 43 ft', 'Six sites have concrete pads and walkways', 'located behind historic dunes in the pine flatwoods. Although there are no ocean or gulf views, the campsites are only a quarter-mile from the beach', 'Hammock camping opportunities are available in every campsite') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facility 37 (VehicleLength 26-43, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/dr-julian-g-bruce-st-george-island-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('a dump station that is nearby', 'There are two restrooms with hot showers, a playground'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521, up to 11 months ahead. The two Gap Point primitive sites (hike or paddle in) and the youth/group camp are arranged through the park office.

For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 60 sites (54 online), 50-amp electric and water, max 43 ft, one pull-through, showers and a dump station, reservable 11 months ahead.
